description: Dash calibration cross-check: cast Afterburner (cast_type dash, dash_distance 14) and confirm the live player displaces close to the authored 14 blocks (dash_impulse + before/after dev position), validating the single dash impulse calibration across distances.
notes: Afterburner is a dash (dash_distance 14) with an 8s ember trail; test mobs line gives an aim target.
Cross-checks the DASH_IMPULSE_CALIBRATION constant against a different authored distance: before/after dev position delta should land near 14 blocks.
Relocates to a flatlands platform (open-air, 61x61) first so generated canyon structures do not block the dash and mask horizontal displacement.
